name: Corridor
desc: An endless one-point-perspective corridor dollying forward forever — ribbed concrete bays sweep past, doorways open and close on the walls, and a raking light wanders down the shaft toward the lit portal at the vanishing point.

energy.doc: light amplitude + camera drift + fixture glow

scale.doc: corridor width/height vs frame (2.2 = cavernous, fills the frame)

density.doc: number of bays receding into depth

x.doc: vanishing point x as canvas fraction

y.doc: eye-level / vanishing point y as canvas fraction

doors.doc: how often a bay carries a recessed doorway

style.doc: aesthetic: mass-and-raking-light concrete / cyan schematic line drawing / hatched engraved plate / sodium-vapour night (form from light only) / flat institutional daylight

seed.doc: deterministic seed for bay tones, doorways and dead fixtures
